cache.title: Completed cache maintenance
cache.description: Releases completed .data spool files after a successful provider upload or an exact fresh-list match. Canonical state, History, active tasks and provider objects are preserved.
cache.confirm_release: Release completed spool cache only? Canonical state, History, active tasks and provider data are preserved.

active.description: Cloud Sync PUTs are durably spooled and ACKed first. A fresh 115 listing skips an upload when any same-name file has the same size and SHA-1. Otherwise OpenList uploads the spool and marks it completed on provider API success. Temporary errors keep the spool and retry in Processing; retries first check whether 115 already has the exact content.
active.confirm_batch_reupload: Directly re-upload the selected tasks from the durable local spool. Count:
active.confirm_pause_all: Pause all pausable active tasks? In-flight uploads will stop as soon as possible while keeping the durable local spool.
active.confirm_reupload_all: Immediately re-upload every eligible task to the provider from the durable local spool? Exact existing 115 content is checked first.
active.confirm_cancel_one: Fail this task and abandon the current local payload? WebDAV will expose the path as missing so Cloud Sync can automatically upload a fresh generation.
active.confirm_cancel_selected: Fail the selected tasks and return them to Cloud Sync. Count:
active.confirm_cancel_all: Fail all active file tasks? Their WebDAV paths will be exposed as missing so Cloud Sync can automatically upload fresh generations.
active.failed_auto_reupload: Confirmation failed; waiting for automatic Cloud Sync re-upload

history.delete_description: Deletes only WebDAVWritebackHistory audit rows. It cannot change current canonical state, spool/provider data, or trigger re-upload. Set retention days to 0 to delete all matching rows immediately.
history.confirm_selected: Delete selected History rows only. Count:
history.success_age_required: Successful History cleanup requires a positive age.
history.confirm_class_safety: Current canonical/spool/provider state is untouched; 0 days means immediate cleanup.
history.status_description: Final Status is the operator-facing answer. Raw historical result, recovery type and old errors are retained under Advanced for audit only.
history.older_than_days_hint: 0 means no age limit and deletes all matching history rows immediately.

settings.title: Writeback settings
settings.description: Cloud Sync PUTs are durably spooled and ACKed first. A fresh 115 listing skips an upload when any same-name file has the same size and SHA-1. Otherwise provider API success completes the task. Temporary errors keep the spool in Processing and retry with backoff; each retry checks 115 for an upload that may have succeeded before its response was lost.
settings.verify_attempts: Confirmed missing checks before source resend

rebuild.title: Full rebuild / gap check
rebuild.description: Rebuild runs in the background. Current PUTs finish first; GET, HEAD, and PROPFIND remain available, while new writes get 503 with Retry-After. OpenList clears its writeback records and local .part/.data spool files, including orphans. It never deletes 115 files. A fresh 115 listing that finds any same-name file with matching size and SHA-1 completes without another upload.
rebuild.confirm: Start a full rebuild? OpenList will clear its writeback records and local spool files after current PUTs finish. Files on 115 will not be deleted; new Cloud Sync writes will retry later.
rebuild.started: Full rebuild started in the background.
rebuild.already_running: A full rebuild is already running.
